comments.label: ui
comments.text: On page load, both here in the review pane, but also on the published-to-Github version, I often see a flash of old control panel styling before the new one fully loads. Across the board, I never want to see that. If assets are still loading, you should use the loading motif we've developed before.

comments.label: separationChart
comments.text: On the published-to-Github version of these episodes, the control panel is longer than it should be, and extends to be tucked behind the playback/chapter pane. The small gap I see here on the review pane looks great; it just needs to make it onto the pubslihed-to-Git version.

comments.label: separationChart
comments.text: All episodes must have the sticky "Current Episode:" top banner to ensure readers know what objects they're looking at even when they scroll far down the control panel. As a reminder, it should read: "Current Episode: [Chaser satellite, in gold] + [Target satellite, in gray". If one of those roles has a dropdown, please put it in its appropriate spot. As a reminder, chaser-identified satellites (whatever appears in the Object A column of the library backend) is always gold, even when users toggle the which-satellite-is-in-the-center button on the 3D globe when its in a relative motion frame.

comments.label: dwellMetric
comments.text: I've made this comment before, but I'll make it again. Across all episodes, the dwell description can go ahead and just all-caps and italicize all satellite names.
